hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a custom AMM curve backed by Euler Finance lending vaults. In `beforeSwap`, it handles the full swap execution: depositing input tokens into an Euler vault and withdrawing output tokens from another, enforcing a custom bonding curve invariant (CurveLib) and returning a BeforeSwapDelta to the pool manager.
